title: Nambu Lowu Pavulaka Timbilu
intro: Anakanya vuthu leri nga eku macheni, ri ri ni torha naswona ri ringiwile, laha xileriso xin’we eribuweni ra nambu xi nga ta hambanisa ku tiyimisela ni ku navela. Murhangeri la hlawuriweke u kongomisa mintlawa eka nala wa matimba, a rhwala ku tshemba Allah ntsena.
clues: Ndzi hlawuriwile hi Allah tani hi murhangeri ehenhla ka Vana va Israel endzhaku ka loko va kombele un’we ku lwa hi ndlela ya Yena.
Ndzi nyikiwe vutivi byo tala ni ku leha tanihi xikombiso xa ku hlawuriwa ka mina, hambileswi vanhu va mina a va kanakana vulawuri bya mina.
Ndzi teke riendzo ni mavuthu kutani ndzi ma byela leswaku Allah u ta ma ringa hi nambu.
Ndzi tsundzuxe leswaku mani na mani loyi a nwaka a ntshunxekile eka yona a nga ta va wa mina, handle ka loyi a nga tshovela voko.
Ndzi tsemakanye ni vanhu va nga ri vangani lava tshameke va tiyile, ndzi langutane ni vuthu lerikulu swinene hi nhlayo.
Ndzi rhangele lava va vuleke leswaku i kangani khamphani leyitsongo yi hlula leyikulu hi mpfumelelo wa Allah, Jalut a nga si hluriwa.

trial.label: Xikambelo/Xiendlakalo
options: Ku aka ngalava emahlweni ka ndhambi
Ku etlela ebakweni ku ringana malembe yo tala
Ku ringeta vuthu hi nambu emahlweni ka nyimpi
trial.answer: Ku ringeta vuthu hi nambu emahlweni ka nyimpi

outcome.label: Mbuyelo
options: Ku mita hi misava hi xuma
Ku hundzuka ku va tindlopfu hikwalaho ka ku tlula nawu
Ku lovisiwa hi ku buluka lokukulu
Ku hlula hi mpfumelelo wa Allah naswona Jalut u dlayiwile hi Dawud
outcome.answer: Ku hlula hi mpfumelelo wa Allah naswona Jalut u dlayiwile hi Dawud

arabic: فَلَمَّا فَصَلَ طَالُوتُ بِٱلْجُنُودِ قَالَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ مُبْتَلِيكُم بِنَهَرٍۢ فَمَن شَرِبَ مِنْهُ فَلَيْسَ مِنِّى وَمَن لَّمْ يَطْعَمْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ مِنِّىٓ إِلَّا مَنِ ٱغْتَرَفَ غُرْفَةًۢ بِيَدِهِۦ ۚ فَشَرِبُوا۟ مِنْهُ إِلَّا قَلِيلًۭا مِّنْهُمْ ۚ فَلَمَّا جَاوَزَهُۥ هُوَ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ قَالُوا۟ لَا طَاقَةَ لَنَا ٱلْيَوْمَ بِجَالُوتَ وَجُنُودِهِۦ ۚ قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ يَظُنُّونَ أَنَّهُم مُّلَـٰقُوا۟ ٱللَّهِ كَم مِّن فِئَةٍۢ قَلِيلَةٍ غَلَبَتْ فِئَةًۭ كَثِيرَةًۢ بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰبِرِينَ
verse: And when Saul went forth with the soldiers, he said, "Indeed, Allāh will be testing you with a river. So whoever drinks from it is not of me, and whoever does not taste it is indeed of me, excepting one who takes [from it] in the hollow of his hand." But they drank from it, except a [very] few of them. Then when he had crossed it along with those who believed with him, they said, "There is no power for us today against Goliath and his soldiers." But those who were certain that they would meet Allāh said, "How many a small company has overcome a large company by permission of Allāh. And Allāh is with the patient." (2:249)
